chunks: Uthman ibn Isa narrated from one of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Verily Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, revealed to Musa (peace be upon him) that one of your companions is backbiting you, so beware of him. He said, 'O Lord, I do not know him; inform me of him so that I may know him.' He replied, 'O Musa, you found fault with him for his backbiting, and you wish Me to be a backbiter!' He said, 'Then what should I do, O Lord?' Allah, the Exalted, replied, 'Divide your companions into groups of ten, then cast lots between them; the lot will fall on the group of ten in which he is. Then divide them again and cast lots between them, and the lot will fall on him.' He said, 'When the man saw that the lots were being drawn, he stood up and said, O Messenger of Allah, I am your companion! By Allah, I will never repeat it again.'
ai.seo_question: How did Prophet Musa identify the companion who was backbiting him according to divine instruction?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kitab al-Zuhd* illustrates the practical application of *qur'ah* (casting lots) as a divinely sanctioned method for identifying a specific individual among a group, highlighting the balance between divine knowledge and human agency. It underscores the gravity of *ghibah* (backbiting) by showing how even a Prophet could be affected by it, and demonstrates the effectiveness of this indirect identification method in prompting immediate confession and repentance from the culprit.
